title: 第23章 极限重压第24章 基因强化液
content_zh:
视网膜上闪过虚幻的面板提示，江岳原本平静的眼眸深处，猛地爆发出极其明亮的光芒。
这无处不在的重压，简直是天赐的熔炉！
这正是帮他彻底把气血夯实进皮肉深处、踏破凡人发力极限、继续向更高维度蜕变的最关键一步！
“滴——重力提升：2.5倍！”
“滴——重力提升：2.8倍！”
冰冷的机械播报声如同催命的音符，一次次在深井内回荡。
随着时间的推移和重力指数的不断飙升，原本拥挤的场内，还能勉强保持站立姿势的，已经锐减到了不足百人。
绝大多数新兵要么被压力强行压昏，触发了重力室底板的保护机制。
要么就是大字型死死趴在地上，连一根手指头都动弹不得，只能像濒死的鱼一样大口喘息。
“咯咯……咔……”
当重力攀升至2.8倍时，江岳感觉到自己的骨骼也终于开始发出了不堪重负的悲鸣。
这已经逼近了他目前这层皮膜所能承受的物理极限。
如果继续强行硬扛下去，防御层一旦被重压撕裂，必然会严重伤及内脏。
江岳心里很清楚，这与平时扛起重物有着本质的区别。
如果是负重深蹲，以他现在的发力底子，扛起三倍于自己体重的东西根本不在话下。
但这可是重力场的全面覆盖！
这意味着不仅是骨骼和肌肉，就连他体内的血液流速、五脏六腑的重量、甚至眼球受到的牵引力，都在成倍增加！
不过，江岳并没有选择顺势倒下，而是死死咬紧牙关，借着这股逼近极限的重力，不断磨砺、压榨着体内每一丝残存的潜力。
“重力提升：3.0倍！”
“重力提升：3.2倍！”

扑通！扑通！
周围不断有站立的硬汉翻着白眼昏厥过去，随后被履带机器人无情地拖拽出场。
“极限了......”
最终，在又生生熬过了几轮加压之后，江岳的视线也开始阵阵发黑，耳边的轰鸣声盖过了外界的一切声响。
他的极限，也终于到了。
重力室上方的指示灯，赫然定格在了一个令人头皮发麻的数字——3.5倍标准重力！
在意识彻底陷入黑暗、身体向前栽倒的最后一秒，江岳用尽最后的力气扫了一眼四周。
偌大的深井内，竟然还有十多道身影，正如同风中残烛般、摇摇欲坠却又死死地钉在原地，没有倒下。
“到底是历经层层筛选过，如今剩下的果然可怕……不知道这次，我能排到多少名……”
江岳的大脑飞速运转，将这十几个人的面孔死死烙印在脑海中，随后，【安神】词条的保护机制瞬间接管了这具濒临崩溃的躯体。
他双眼一闭，彻底失去了意识，重重地砸在了冰冷的金属底板上。
……
重力深井上方，环形主控室内。
“砰。”
铁腕教官看着屏幕中江岳倒下的身影，眼中不仅没有失望，反而闪过一抹强烈的赞赏。
他转过身，用那条暗红色的机械义肢重重地拍了拍独眼的肩膀。
“算是个可造之材！”
铁腕粗犷的声音里带着一丝难得的肯定，“知道在皮膜崩溃、伤及内脏的绝对极限前一秒收手，算是极限发挥潜能的同时不伤根基。”
“这份对自己身体的掌控力，可称得上优秀了。”
说到这里，铁腕顿了顿，冷酷的眼神中多了一抹期待：“不过，抗压测试只能说明抗击打能力和底盘稳，能否成为真正的武者，可不止看这些，希望你的眼光没错。”

“如果他真能保持这十天来这般恐怖的进步速度……。”
面对铁腕的评价，独眼并没有说话。
他只是静静地看着全息光幕上，那定格在“江岳3.5倍”的数据记录，仅剩的独眼里闪烁着复杂的光芒。
随后，独眼干脆利落地抬起手，默默关掉了眼前的监测终端。
content_en:
An illusory panel prompt flashed on his retina, and an extremely bright light burst out from the depths of Jiang Yue's originally calm eyes.
This ubiquitous pressure is simply a melting pot sent from heaven!
This is the most crucial step to help him completely tamp his energy and blood deep into his flesh, break through the limits of mortal strength, and continue his transformation to a higher dimension!
"Dip - gravity increase: 2.5 times!"
"Dip - gravity increase: 2.8 times!"
The cold mechanical broadcast sound was like a note of urgency, echoing in the deep well again and again.
As time went by and the gravity index continued to soar, the number of people in the originally crowded venue who could barely remain standing has dropped sharply to less than a hundred people.
The vast majority of the recruits were either forcibly knocked unconscious by the pressure, triggering the protective mechanism of the bottom plate of the gravity chamber.
Or the big font is lying on the ground, unable to move a finger, and can only gasp for breath like a dying fish.
"Click... click..."
When the gravity climbed to 2.8 times, Jiang Yue felt that his bones finally began to scream under the weight.
This has approached the physical limit that his current skin can withstand.
If you continue to carry it forcefully, once the defensive layer is torn apart by the heavy pressure, your internal organs will inevitably be seriously injured.
Jiang Yue knew very well that this was fundamentally different from carrying heavy objects in ordinary times.
If it was a weight-bearing squat, with his current strength base, it would be no problem to carry something three times his own weight.
But this is full coverage of the gravity field!
This means that not only the bones and muscles, but also the blood flow rate in his body, the weight of the internal organs, and even the traction force on the eyeballs are increasing exponentially!
However, Jiang Yue did not choose to fall down. Instead, he gritted his teeth and used this gravity approaching the limit to continuously sharpen and squeeze every remaining potential in his body.
"Gravity increase: 3.0 times!"
"Gravity increase: 3.2 times!"
Thump! thump!
Standing tough guys rolled their eyes and fainted, and were then dragged out of the room mercilessly by crawler robots.
"It's the limit..."
Finally, after surviving several rounds of pressure, Jiang Yue's vision began to turn black, and the roaring in his ears drowned out all the sounds from the outside world.
His limit has finally been reached.
The indicator light above the gravity chamber suddenly settled on a mind-numbing number - 3.5 times standard gravity!
At the last second when his consciousness completely fell into darkness and his body fell forward, Jiang Yue used his last strength to glance around.
In the huge deep well, there are actually more than a dozen figures, like candles in the wind, crumbling but firmly nailed to the spot without falling.
"After all, after many layers of screening, what's left is really scary... I don't know how high I will be ranked this time..."
Jiang Yue's brain was working rapidly, imprinting the faces of these dozen people in his mind. Then, the protection mechanism of the [Anshen] entry instantly took over the body that was on the verge of collapse.
He closed his eyes, completely lost consciousness, and hit the cold metal floor heavily.
…
Above the deep gravity well, in the annular main control room.
"Bang."
The iron-fisted instructor looked at Jiang Yue's fallen figure on the screen. Not only was he not disappointed, but there was a flash of strong appreciation in his eyes.
He turned around and patted One-Eye's shoulder heavily with the dark red mechanical prosthetic leg.
"It's a workable material!"
There was a trace of rare certainty in the iron-fisted rough voice, "Knowing to stop one second before the absolute limit of skin membrane collapse and damage to internal organs is a way to maximize your potential without damaging your foundation."
"This ability to control one's own body can be regarded as excellent."
Having said this, Iron Fist paused, and there was a touch of expectation in his cold eyes: "However, the pressure test can only show the ability to withstand blows and the stability of the chassis.Becoming a true warrior requires more than just looking at this. I hope your vision is correct. "
"If he can really maintain this terrifying rate of progress over the past ten days... "
Faced with the iron-fisted evaluation, One Eye did not speak.
He just looked at the holographic light screen quietly, the data record fixed at "Jiang Yue 3.5 times", and the remaining single eye was shining with a complicated light.
Then, One Eye raised his hand neatly and silently turned off the monitoring terminal in front of him.
